difficulty_reason: Prove that a site with fibre products and a subset B which covers every object and is closed under amending coverings admits hypercoverings K of any X with all K_n members in B: reduce to C/X so X is final and finite limits exist (categories-lemma-finite-limits-exist); define n-truncated B-hypercoverings in SR(C), start from the 0-truncated covering given by the assumption on B and note it is split (lemma-split); inductively extend a split n-truncated K to (n+1)-truncated by taking K' = sk_{n+1}(cosk_n K), choosing B-coverings (equation-choose-covering-B) of each U'_{n+1,i'}, building I_{n+1} as the coproduct over surjections [n+1]->[m] of nondegenerate indices plus the chosen J_{i'}, and verifying K_{n+1} -> K'_{n+1} = (cosk_n K)_{n+1} is a covering in the definition-covering-SR sense by splitting into nondegenerate i' (covered by choice of J_{i'}) and degenerate i' (choice plus assumption (2)); define the simplicial maps K(phi) for phi : [m]->[n+1] through K' and for surjections phi : [n+1]->[m] through the nondegenerate factorization psi and the split isomorphisms of lemma-split.
